issues.issue: Whether the claimant's account of police threats and extortion linked to his father is credible
issues.applicant_position: Father's refusal to help an inmate led to threats; police threatened imprisonment.
issues.result_text: Panel finds the claimant's story not credible; only the brother's arrest is corroborated.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant's delay in claiming refugee protection undermines his fear
issues.applicant_position: Waited for the situation in Mexico to improve before claiming.
issues.result_text: Lengthy delay is inconsistent with fear for life and undermines credibility.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant faces persecution or risk to life, torture or cruel treatment if returned to Mexico
issues.applicant_position: Fears imprisonment and violence if returned to Mexico.
issues.result_text: Claimant failed to prove persecution on a Convention ground or risk of torture, life or cruel treatment.
